customer_profile.name: Port of Rotterdam Authority
customer_profile.description: The Port of Rotterdam Authority operates Europe's largest seaport, managing critical maritime infrastructure, cargo handling, and logistics operations. As a vital component of European supply chains, they oversee container terminals, petrochemical facilities, and digital port systems while maintaining security and environmental standards.
